body.label: Effect
body.html: Compare this Action against each creature within 1 unit of the chosen point. Deal 1 Physical damage to each successfully affected target.

surges.html: One successfully affected creature is pushed 1 unit directly away from the chosen point.
Add 1 die to the next Magecraft Action you use before the start of your next turn.
Increase the affected area by 1 unit.

rider.title: SPACE THREAD
rider.html: Consume this Thread before a future Magecraft Action that targets a point. Increase the affected area of that Action by 1 unit.
